author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a four-way cross wrench, two bars crossing at the centre with a round-ended socket cup on each of the four ends; four-fold symmetric. Rejected candidates: with an r3 hub the opposite shafts started 6 apart (MIC) and the hub crowded the sockets; on SQUARE without a hub the shafts were only 4 long and it read as a clover. The rejected drawing had forked (U-shaped) ends instead of sockets.
omissions: The central hub circle is dropped: a hub wide enough to keep opposite shafts 8 apart would sit within 8 of the sockets. Socket ends are round rather than flat with rounded corners.
drawing_plan: CIRCLE: bars (12,24)-(36,24) and (24,12)-(24,36); right socket (36,20)-(40,20)-r4 semicircle to (44,24)-(40,28)-(36,28), turned in 90-degree steps.
lucide_reference: No Lucide lug wrench; straight crossing bars as in 'plus'/'crosshair', round-ended cups.
